description: Read a site's robots.txt and say which AI crawlers may fetch it, separating the ones that retrieve pages to answer live questions from the ones that only collect training data. Blocking the first kind is what makes a site invisible in AI answers; blocking the second costs nothing. Runs locally, no account needed.

url.description: A public site, e.g. example.com or https://example.com

name: check_ai_access
